responsibility: This file implements GCC’s emission of VMS Debug (DST) format information in assembly output. It collects source file, line, function, block, prologue, and module metadata during compilation, writes the corresponding DST records into the .vmsdebug section, and includes host/VMS-specific helpers for obtaining file timestamps and RMS attributes needed by source-correlation records. It is the VMS-specific debug back end parallel to other object-format debug emitters such as DWARF or stabs paths.
